**Analyzing the Lines**

I'm focusing on identifying vertical lines and any single adjacent pixels. I've started with Example 1, noting the length of the line (5) and position of the adjacent pixel. Currently, the thought process is heavily oriented on the relationship between these two components, especially how that will define the output.

**Analyzing Horizontal Lines**

Okay, so I've confirmed the initial hypothesis about line orientation! The horizontal line in Row 3, spanning columns 2 to 10, led me to a few insights: Length is 9, Midpoint column is 6, and the marker pixel is at (3,10). The rule does seem to generalize across both horizontal and vertical cases.
